title: Recover macOS temperature sensors automatically after ReMCP updates.
changes: Repair missing Apple Silicon native thermal sensor binaries after starting the updated agent, even when the previous CLI installer lacked the launchd PATH fix.
Keep the agent connection responsive while a separate vetted, version-pinned macos-temperature-sensor@2.1.1 worker builds the native addon, with no privileged operation or unrelated npm scripts.
Skip the repair worker for non-macOS devices and custom runtimes; preserve truthful unavailable readings if native compilation cannot run.
